svg.title: Vibe coding without and with Shaka
svg.desc: Without Shaka, the AI edits your project directly. Tests run only if you remember to ask, nobody double-checks the work, it is hard to see what changed and why, and bugs can slip through. With Shaka, the AI's edits come as suggestions, like suggesting mode in Google Docs. Your tests run before you see the result, a second AI looks for mistakes, you see every change with proof in a pull request, and by default the agent waits for your yes.

g.text: The AI edits your project directly
✗ Tests run only if you remember to ask
✗ Hard to see what changed and why
The AI's edits come as suggestions
✓ Your tests run before you see the result
✓ A second AI looks for mistakes
✓ You see every change, with proof
✓ By default, the agent waits for your yes
